title: Kalyumet Camping & Cabins

services.name: RV & Tent Sites
services.desc: We offer 30 amp or 50 amp full hook-up RV sites, water & electric pop-up or tent sites and no hook-up tent sites. There is free Wi-Fi throughout the park. If you want to enjoy a camping experience without sleeping outdoors, pamper yourself by staying in our 2 bedroom luxury log cabin. Our immaculate cabin features air conditioning, full kitchen and bath, satellite TV & heated pool. Bed linens are supplied but you must provide your own towels and toiletries. See Cabins Info & Rates here. Or consider staying in one of our rental rooms. Each room is air conditioned and has a queen size bed or 2 double beds, table, chairs and a small refrigerator.
